UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User profile with high scores and aggregated memory statistics.

userId.description: The Firebase Auth UID of the user.

bestScore.description: Highest number of digits correctly memorized and recalled.

totalSessions.description: Total number of completed practice or test sessions.

totalDigitsRecalled.description: Cumulative count of correct digits typed across all sessions.

lastActiveDate.description: Date of last practice session in YYYY-MM-DD format.

PracticeSession.title: PracticeSession
PracticeSession.description: Record of an individual memorization session or test run.

durationSeconds.description: Duration of the session in seconds.

mode.description: Session mode: full_test, chunk_practice, or flashcard.

targetChunk.description: Identifier or range of chunk practiced, e.g. 'all', '1-50', etc.

firstMistakeIndex.description: The 0-based digit index where the first error occurred, or -1 if perfect.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the session was completed.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores user-level stats, best score, streak, and preferences.

/users/{userId}/sessions/{sessionId}.description: Stores history of memorization and practice sessions for the user.
